reviews.text: Can recommend for rodents. I take all my rats here, where they usually see Mari or Gisle who are both very knowledgeable and experienced with rats (at least they should be by now, given the frequency I take the little twerps there). The vets are typically very thorough with the examination and give great care to wee little doofuses who get sick way too often.

We received excellent and professional service when our rabbit was castrated at Karhupuisto.
The entire operation went smoothly and I felt that we were in good hands. The rabbit was only discharged home when he was fully awake and alert. The price was also very reasonable.
I recommend Karhupuisto as a competent veterinary clinic for rabbits.
Really good care and nice service at a reasonable price :)

Came here to treat my rabbit with unusual poop. Vet showed up about 20 minutes late, and when he arrived, he went to treat another patient first. Vet seemed friendly and experienced but was the only doctor there that day, so he was treating multiple animals at once, which made our experience feel a bit rushed. After we left, the care instructions provided to us had many spelling mistakes, which I don't believe is safe when it comes to health-related matters. Most importantly, the vet did not treat/tackle the issue at hand which we came for.

I am dissatisfied with the service at this clinic. Our veterinarian was Ilona Harju. The cat was not examined thoroughly, and after the appointment we realized that we still had many unanswered questions and that our problem had not been resolved.
We came in because of appetite issues. They only took a blood test, told us to change the food, and gave an anti-nausea injection. The cat was not palpated, and her mouth was not examined at all. An ultrasound was not even suggested.
No clear diagnosis was made, and it was not explained what exactly the problem was. In the end, their “treatment” was simply changing the food. This helped for two days, and then the cat stopped eating again.
We will be seeking help at another clinic.
Good and reasonably priced vet. 2 cats as clients.
The Chinese Crested Dog received excellent and expert service during a dental operation. I often use the caregivers for smaller matters, warm and caring service. Highly recommended!
Full 5 stars! Our dog suddenly injured himself and we received quick and good care even though they were fully booked for the day! Thank you for the great service, you saved our day😍 …
Expert and fast service. Highly recommended.

It's great that there are still warm-hearted and expert veterinarians like Karhupuisto. The pet's sterilization went really well, the care instructions were clear and the price was also really reasonable. I can recommend it! 😊 …
They always take care of our rabbits when it’s an emergency and the service is great
Very warm and friendly place with truly professional service. Also suitable for pets that get scared easily.
The best place for a cat to visit!

Great place! The nurses at the Karhupuisto small animal clinic are helpful, empathetic and considerate. Really friendly and professional service overall. The clinic doesn't feel rushed, but pets and their people are met over time, which is a special plus! I've been there with my cat several times and here they put the pet's well-being first, always thinking about what's best for the animal. I've recommended this place to several cat friends and they've only had positive experiences!

We have been to Karhupuisto Small Animal Clinic quite a few times for our dog's anal gland problems and other issues and we have always received good service at a reasonable price. The staff, both veterinarians and nurses, are really nice and empathetic. Thank you ❤️
I've taken my cat here multiple times and they have always been very helpful. They took very good care of him and explained everything patiently.
The rabbit's life was saved. The employees were nice and knowledgeable.
Having been to this place several times, I can recommend it!

We went to check the lump that had appeared on the cat's earlobe. After the check, the doctor suddenly asked us, after he had already started writing the treatment instructions, if we wanted to remove the lump, and that it would be successful. The lump is the size of a pinhead and the doctor had stated that it was harmless, comparable to a wound. I think it is unethical to offer such a heavy procedure to a cat as anesthesia and surgical removal. In addition, there was a typo in the home care instructions written by the doctor or nurse, where it referred to an ointment and in brackets there were completely different products. We tried to go to the clinic again to change the product, but it was unsuccessful. The typo did not cause a treatment error, but additional purchases. When I made a complaint about this by email and asked for 17€ in compensation, the doctor started to challenge us on the phone, asking if there had been a treatment error?! Feel free to file a lawsuit!! The entire visit was very unprofessional, where the nurses/doctor were not aware of the reason why we came to the appointment and the cat's best interests did not seem to be a priority. After the complaint, the customer service was aggressive and offensive.
The cat's tartar removal went really well. The staff was very professional and friendly and we received good aftercare instructions. We will definitely come again! 🐈‍⬛💜 …
